prompt: I need you to help triage a bug before we file it. Our production deployment pipeline for the `openforge/dbmigrate` project keeps crashing due to connection pool exhaustion — when we run many migration jobs in parallel, the system runs out of connections and everything falls over. Before we formally file a new bug report for this, I want to make sure we're not duplicating something the team is already working on. Please do a thorough check of the existing issues and pull requests on that project, read any relevant threads you find, and then save your complete findings and recommendation to a file called `triage_report.md` in the project folder.
